characters.description: young queen with a short black bob of hair sitting on top of her egg head, a thin gold cobra crown band, a broad gold collar necklace, a white linen dress with a royal-blue sash, clever confident eyebrows
early king wearing the tall combined white-and-red double crown of Egypt, a short white kilt, holding a stone ceremonial mace
proud pharaoh with a tall blue war crown, gold armbands, a red-and-white striped kilt and a gold crook, very smug eyebrows
modern astronaut in a white spacesuit with the gold visor pushed up so his pebble-head face shows
young scholar from the 1820s with messy dark hair on top of his egg head and a dark blue tailcoat, holding a magnifying glass

beats.visual: A long horizontal measuring ruler stretches across a desert. At the far left end tiny workers start building the Great Pyramid; at the far right end an astronaut plants a flag on the Moon. Cleopatra stands on the ruler much closer to the astronaut, looking back over her shoulder at the distant pyramid with shocked eyebrows.
The three pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx at golden sunset, enormous and weathered, sand drifting; one tiny traveller with a walking stick looks up at them in awe.

Narmer stands on a riverbank holding the white crown of the south in one hand and the red crown of the north in the other, pushing them together into one double crown, while cheering crowds on both banks of the river wave flags.

The Nile overflows its banks across a wide green valley between desert cliffs; happy farmers wade through the shallow flood carrying baskets as thick black mud spreads over the fields and wheat sprouts behind them.
A pharaoh wearing a golden sun-disk halo like a god proudly unrolls a giant blueprint of an absurdly huge pyramid in front of three sweating architects whose eyebrows shoot up in panic.
High aerial view of the Great Pyramid half-built in the desert, with an endless winding line of stone blocks on wooden sledges stretching to the horizon, pulled by thousands of tiny workers.

Pyramid workers line up at a wooden table where a scribe with a papyrus ledger hands out bread loaves and jugs of beer as their daily pay; the workers grin and flex their arms; a half-built pyramid stands behind them.

Foreign warriors in fast war chariots pulled by galloping horses thunder across the desert toward an Egyptian town, kicking up dust, while Egyptian foot soldiers stare in shock with their spears drooping.
Egyptian soldiers now driving their own war chariots chase the fleeing invaders across the desert, banners flying, a grinning Egyptian charioteer pointing forward.
Ramesses sits on a giant golden throne in front of four colossal stone statues of himself, looking extremely pleased with himself while two servants fan him with palm leaves.
An elderly, exhausted pharaoh slumps asleep on a dusty throne with a drooping crown and cobwebs on his staff, a candle melted almost to nothing and an hourglass running out beside him.

Four foreign kings stand in a queue beside a single Egyptian throne: a Libyan chief, a Nubian king, a Persian king and a Greek king in their distinct costumes, each glaring impatiently at the one in front of him.
Cleopatra on her throne in a palace overlooking the harbour of Alexandria and its great lighthouse, confident and clever, holding a scroll.
Roman legionaries in red tunics and plumed helmets march in tight rows past the pyramids carrying an eagle standard, while Egyptian locals watch sadly from the roadside.
A confused scholar in a robe scratches his head in front of a huge temple wall covered in hieroglyph carvings, big question marks floating above him.
A giant stone wall of hieroglyph carvings wrapped in heavy iron chains with a huge padlock, half buried by sand dunes under a starry night sky.
A young scholar holds a magnifying glass up to a tall dark stone slab carved with three bands of different scripts, his eyebrows shooting up in excitement and a glowing light bulb above his head.
The Great Pyramid at night under a giant full moon; on the moon a tiny astronaut waves down at the pyramid.
